changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.0 adds per-channel Standard TV quality (480p, 720p or 1080p), Clone Channel, Android TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning compatibility, an optional Hide from Android TV setting for Personalized channels, and a dedicated Personalized TV handoff for Jellyfin for Android phones/tablets. Web and webOS behavior remains unchanged. Existing Standard TV channels keep the historical 720p setting until edited; new Standard TV channels default to 1080p.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.
